recommendation: Keep the commit as a source cleanup for FHIR-13345. The public specification behavior was already aligned, and this prevents stale internal guidance from referring to the removed standard alias extension.
issue_request: FHIR-13345 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 by Patient Administration and requested removing the standard alias-name extensions for Organization and Location because the resources had alias elements.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied by commit ca3ede7696342ef6934f7a100c37d31093bfc23a, which removed alias rows from the Organization and Location extension spreadsheets. Current source already has Organization.alias and Location.alias as 0..* string elements and no active organization-alias or location-alias extension definitions.
additional_context: FHIR-9624 and FHIR-9625 are the earlier Published/Persuasive decisions establishing Location.alias and Organization.alias and including those elements in name search. Organization and Location are active resources in source/fhir.ini. The public CI build already strips build-only committee notes and shows the correct Organization.alias behavior, but the active Organization source still retained a stale committee note telling editors to use an extension "alias" instead.
reconciliation: Removed the stale build committee note from source/organization/structuredefinition-Organization.xml. No changes were needed for Location.alias, Organization.alias, or their search parameters.
source_changes: Removed the Organization.name build committee note that recommended using an extension "alias" from source/organization/structuredefinition-Organization.xml.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Published/Persuasive Location decision to add Location.alias and include it in name search, explaining why the later standard extension was redundant.
Earlier Published/Persuasive Organization decision to add Organization.alias through the FHIR-9624 resolution, explaining why the later standard extension was redundant.
